solution.final_text:
The note is /journal/2026-11-17-dewar-hold-time.md — Zoe's journal entry on the third cooldown run: the dewar's hold time fell short of a full observing run because the glycol loop cycled and the radiative load through the open slit exceeded the second-stage capacity, so the CCD stage drifted above its operating temperature before dawn. The camera-fogging risk (the film crew's camera), the summit closure (cold weather overnight) and Ridgeline's cold storage are not it.

